blocked_reason: Cline CLI needs a provider API key and a model turn before any team tool runs. No key is configured in this environment, and this task must not change the target's config. Note: the npm package `@cline/cli` is a stub (0.0.13, binary `clite`); the real package is `cline`.

doc_based_schema.scope: Team state belongs to one session; no discovery of unrelated sessions.
doc_based_schema.persistence: ~/.cline/data/db/teams.db keyed by session ID; restored on `cline --id <session-id>`
doc_based_schema.approval: approving spawn_agent/teams covers the subagent's later tool calls; approval settings do not apply inside a subagent
